locked_interpretations.alignment: Exact spec box convention; possible convolution-center mismatch is a spec limitation, not silently corrected.
locked_interpretations.physiology_kd: Exact per-class weighted ratio, epsilon=1e-8; positive scalar patient weights nearly cancel at batch1. Intentional zero weights skip/log KD, global collapse fails closed.
locked_interpretations.clear_harm_reduction: Paired patient bootstrap95 lower bound of harm(V1u)-harm(V1) greater than0; fixed before real data.
locked_interpretations.logical_updates: USER_CONFIRMED: J8000 paired logical updates =8000 optimizer steps; each pair accumulates separate L/U forwards. C0 same8000L/8000optim. Spec9 accumulation2 means stream microbatches, not two pairs. Confirmed before real data.
locked_interpretations.c1: Train-only AS64->actual CT projection compares actual aligned teacher features, removed at export.
locked_interpretations.tokenizer_gate: Soft class mass accumulated across declared cohort/window; strict majority >50%, not plurality or final minibatch.
locked_interpretations.tokenizer_init: 200-volume initialization pass is separate from1000 Q optimizer updates.
locked_interpretations.pretrained_classifier: Exact compatible region classifier required; no silent head reinitialization.
locked_interpretations.missing_myocardium: No unrequested guard beyond spec; absent myocardium at both phases remains an explicit formula limitation.
locked_interpretations.joint_loss_scaling: L supervised coefficient1 in everyarm; codeKD and commitment averaged over participating L/U streams; no blanket division of supervised loss by stream_count.
locked_interpretations.student_collapse: After ramp warmup, a complete rolling 200-update window assigning all student cells to one code is a collapse and stops J. Short synthetic windows are NOT_EVALUATED, not PASS. Locked before real data.
locked_interpretations.checkpoint_schema: Research resume.v2 contains weights-only-safe RNG state and mandatory SHA sidecar; old prototype resume.v1 is rejected. Complete optimizer-pair checkpoint resume only.
locked_interpretations.patient_macro_dice: Mean finite frame Dice within each patient/class, then mean class scores and mean patients; shared selection/reporting policy (E6 correction before real data).
locked_interpretations.baseline_source_snapshot: A-3D source_inventory pins the whole self_audit tree plus train/evaluate. Train and evaluate each A-3D campaign baseline in the same frozen delivery commit/worktree; keep the checkpoint source_files/source_sha256 and use its pinned worktree after later source edits. Rejecting changed code is intentional fail-closed behavior, not relaxed for Q3D.
locked_interpretations.official_teacher_feature_channels: Pinned MedNeXt-v1 L k3 actual source probe: stride4=128, stride8=256, stride16=512. Canonical channel metadata and C1 projection must match this source; synthetic feature widths are not substituted as official evidence.
